name: Smart Contract Tooling, Testing & DevOps
description: Development environments, local testnets, and CI/CD automation: Foundry (Forge/Cast/Anvil), Hardhat, Tenderly debuggers, decentralized storage (IPFS/Arweave), and automated fuzz testing tools.

subskills.name: Hardhat Development Environment & Plugins
subskills.description: Configuring Hardhat (`hardhat.config.ts`), Hardhat Network, typechain bindings, hardhat-deploy, and custom TypeScript tasks.

subskills.name: Foundry Toolchain (Forge, Cast, Anvil)
subskills.description: High-performance Rust-based Ethereum toolkit: fast compiling (`forge build`), script deployments (`forge script`), RPC queries (`cast`), and local node (`anvil`).

subskills.name: Developer Wallets & Testnet Tooling
subskills.description: Managing programmatic signer wallets, private keys in `.env`, mnemonic generation, faucet APIs, and test ether funding strategies.

subskills.name: Decentralized Storage Tooling (IPFS, Arweave, Filecoin)
subskills.description: Pinning services (Pinata, Web3.Storage), IPFS CLI node management, Arweave permanent storage upload tools (Irys/Bundlr), and decentralized pinning gateways.

subskills.name: EVM Execution Trace Debugging & Tenderly
subskills.description: Transaction call trace analysis, opcode-by-opcode debugging, Tenderly Virtual TestNets, simulation APIs, and revert reason decoding.

subskills.name: Automated Multi-Chain Contract Verification
subskills.description: Automated sourcify and standard-json-input verification with `forge verify-contract` and hardhat-verify across Etherscan and Blockscout APIs.

subskills.name: Smart Contract CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions)
subskills.description: Automated GitHub Actions workflows for building, gas snapshot regression testing (`forge snapshot`), linting (solhint, prettier), and automated PR feedback.

subskills.name: Fuzzing Tooling & Automated Test Orchestration (Medusa, Echidna)
subskills.description: Configuring and running modern smart contract fuzzer tools (Medusa, Echidna) in automated security regression suites.

subskills.name: Gas Profiling & Snapshot Regression Tooling
subskills.description: Continuous gas benchmarking using `forge snapshot --diff`, hardhat-gas-reporter, identifying opcode-level gas spikes, and gas budget gating.

github.signal: Foundry config, Hardhat config, and package.json smart contract scripts
Tenderly simulation config, Pinata/Arweave pinning scripts, and verification commands
GitHub Actions workflows running Forge test, Forge snapshot, Medusa, or Echidna

cv.signal: Configured Hardhat and Foundry development toolchains with automated unit testing and contract verification
Built CI/CD automated testing pipelines with gas regression snapshots, Tenderly simulations, and IPFS pinning

linkedin.signal: Expertise in Foundry, Hardhat, Smart Contract Tooling, CI/CD Pipelines, and Tenderly Debugging

assessment.signal: Passes smart contract tooling assessment covering Foundry cheatcodes, CI/CD pipeline automation, Tenderly traces, and gas snapshot gates

junior.description: Uses Foundry (forge/cast/anvil) and Hardhat for compiling, local testing, and managing dev testnet wallets.

mid.description: Integrates IPFS/Arweave storage, inspects execution traces on Tenderly, and verifies contracts programmatically.

senior.description: Architects smart contract CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, sets up gas snapshot regression gates, and integrates Medusa/Echidna fuzzer suites.
